work_items.title: Freeze the .harborgame package and signing contract
work_items.description: In Neo Grounds, define deterministic .harborgame archive construction, canonical creator-signing payloads, schema validation, bounded extraction policy inputs, and valid/tampered golden fixtures. Export the canonical schema and fixtures for Harbor compatibility tests. Source: docs/tickets/harbor-games/source-spec.md at the Harbor games branch and Neo Grounds runtime contract a5cfa14.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Neo Grounds builds a deterministic archive from a real minimal WASM package; independent validation rejects path traversal, duplicate paths, undeclared files, digest changes, malformed identities, and signature changes; Harbor can consume the versioned schema and golden fixtures without undocumented assumptions.

work_items.title: Implement Harbor game authentication and package signing
work_items.description: Add domain-separated, bounded Harbor identity signing commands and confirmation UI for Neo Grounds login challenges and finalized game package digests. Extend deep-link routing for the exact trusted games origin without exposing private keys or creating a general raw-signing oracle.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: An unlocked identity can explicitly approve and sign valid short-lived Neo Grounds auth and package requests; locked, expired, replayed, wrong-origin, oversized, malformed, and cross-domain requests fail; tests prove no command accepts arbitrary bytes or returns private key material.

work_items.title: Implement Sign in with Harbor verification
work_items.description: Add durable Neo Grounds challenge, proof-verification, account-link, and session endpoints. Verify Harbor peer ID/public-key derivation and Ed25519 signatures atomically with nonce consumption, expiry, audience binding, request limits, and audit records.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: A valid Harbor proof links one identity to the intended Neo Grounds account and creates a secure browser session; replay, expiry, account swap, origin swap, key substitution, signature mutation, and concurrent proof submission fail without partial links; state survives service restart.

work_items.title: Add Neo Grounds Harbor sign-in and package-signing UI
work_items.description: Add optional Sign in with Harbor account linking and publication-time package signing to Neo Grounds. Creation and Neo-only play remain available without Harbor; Harbor-store submission clearly requires linking and explicit package signing.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: The browser initiates the versioned Harbor deep link, reports pending/approved/expired/failed state, obtains a session only after valid proof, and separately requests package signing with visible title, digest, permissions, and creator identity. Cancel and failure never submit or publish a package.

work_items.title: Build the durable moderated Neo Grounds Harbor store service
work_items.description: Replace demo-only store paths with durable metadata, immutable NAS package storage, signed submissions, operator approval/rejection/withdrawal, approved catalog, package download, audit records, quotas, and health endpoints rooted under /mnt/nas/neo-grounds.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Linked creators submit creator-signed immutable packages; only an authenticated allowlisted reviewer can approve or reject; only approved packages appear or download; tampering and invalid transitions fail; concurrent submission/approval is atomic; catalog, decisions, and bytes survive restart; backup/restore is tested.

work_items.title: Build the embeddable Neo Grounds Harbor store
work_items.description: Implement the dedicated catalog/search/detail/submission-status/admin routes for embedding at games.social-harbor.com. Emit only the closed versioned install-intent message and configure restrictive framing, CSP, navigation, and content headers.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Anonymous users browse only approved games; linked creators see their submission state; the operator reviews submissions; the embedded route emits validated identifiers rather than URLs or code; browser tests prove disallowed framing, navigation, message, and unapproved-content paths fail.

work_items.title: Implement Harbor's validated local game library
work_items.description: Add Rust repositories and services for managed package storage, manual .harborgame import, configurable non-recursive folder discovery, atomic installation/update/uninstall, creator/store verification, permissions, profile isolation, and local save metadata.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Manual import and folder discovery install valid signed fixtures into managed immutable storage; malformed archives, traversal, symlinks, undeclared files, quota excess, incompatible ABI, and all signature/digest mutations fail without runnable partial state; two profiles cannot access each other's approvals, saves, or history; failed updates preserve the installed version.

work_items.title: Run Neo Grounds WASM packages safely inside Harbor
work_items.description: Implement the Worker-isolated Neo Grounds v1 lifecycle and Canvas 2D command-buffer player in Harbor, with input, audio boundary, fullscreen, lifecycle cleanup, offline launch, deny-by-default capabilities, measured resource limits, and actionable crash states.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: A real golden WASM game initializes, updates, renders, receives input, shuts down, and relaunches offline; unsupported imports and multiplayer fail before launch; direct DOM/network/filesystem/Tauri access is absent; measured limits and protected failure modes are documented and tested; a trapped or stalled game does not corrupt Harbor state or remain active after navigation.

work_items.title: Add Harbor Games navigation, library, and embedded store
work_items.description: Add the Games tab, local library, import/folder settings, game detail/play surface, sandboxed Neo Grounds iframe, exact-origin install bridge, independent metadata resolution, install confirmation, offline state, permissions, errors, and uninstall/save controls.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Users browse the embedded approved catalog, confirm an origin-checked install, import or discover local packages, launch installed games locally, and understand offline/error/permission state; forged origins/messages and remote package URLs cannot trigger installation; accessibility and keyboard navigation tests pass.

work_items.title: Deploy Neo Grounds store on gx10
work_items.description: Deploy the production Neo Grounds store service on gx10 with loopback binding, constrained supervision, /mnt/nas/neo-grounds storage, backup/restore, health checks, logs, TLS tunnel ingress, DNS for games.social-harbor.com, restrictive headers, and rollback documentation. Preserve existing social-harbor.com and unrelated gx10 services.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: games.social-harbor.com serves the intended store and API over valid HTTPS; origin service is not publicly bound; unrelated routes/services remain unchanged; restart and restore preserve approved data; health/rollback checks pass; no credentials enter repositories or logs; Harbor can frame only the store route and API CORS is minimal.

work_items.title: Complete games origin DNS and TLS cutover
work_items.description: After the operator rotates the previously exposed infrastructure credential, replace the authoritative games.social-harbor.com record through the externally managed DNS provider with a route that reaches the validated gx10 tunnel ingress. Confirm valid public TLS, exact store/API routing, restrictive headers, no public origin listener, and unchanged unrelated sites. Source: games-0500 run 88 and Neo Grounds docs/gx10-deployment.md at a15d01b.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Credential rotation is explicitly confirmed; games.social-harbor.com resolves to the intended tunnel-backed service and serves valid HTTPS store/API responses; origin remains loopback-only; unrelated routes remain unchanged; sanitized evidence is recorded.

work_items.title: Validate Harbor game creation-to-offline-play
work_items.description: Run the complete production-shaped path across Neo Grounds, Harbor, gx10, and NAS: Harbor sign-in, real WASM build, creator signing, moderation, embedded discovery, installation, local play, tamper rejection, folder discovery, profile isolation, restart, and offline replay. Capture sanitized evidence and audit every source requirement.
work_items.acceptance_criteria: Every delivery-acceptance scenario in source-spec.md passes against packaged Harbor and the deployed HTTPS store; full Harbor and Neo Grounds checks pass; adversarial signature/archive/origin/replay tests pass; diff and deployment evidence are captured; no acceptance criterion is skipped or replaced by a limitation.
